name: hardware-delivery
description: Hardware e-hailing & delivery marketplace for South Africa (customers, hardware stores, drivers, admin).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @hardware-delivery/backend && npm run build -w @hardware-delivery/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @hardware-delivery/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @hardware-delivery/backend" "npm run dev -w @hardware-delivery/frontend"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @hardware-delivery/backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @hardware-delivery/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @hardware-delivery/backend && npm run typecheck -w @hardware-delivery/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @hardware-delivery/backend && npm run test -w @hardware-delivery/frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @hardware-delivery/backend
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run migration:run -w @hardware-delivery/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @hardware-delivery/backend
scripts.db:reset: npm run build:shared && npm run db:reset -w @hardware-delivery/backend
